upstreamWatchdog.observation: Completed-job watchdog sleeps for max(processEvery / 2, lockLifetime / 2) before checking its stopped flag; it does not access a closed backend. Existing upstream timer behavior is unchanged. The fixture uses an explicit 1000ms lockLifetime for bounded process exit, without changing production defaults.
